title: Crvena Zvezda sweep Partizan to lift the trophy
description: Partizan - Crvena Zvezda 76-82 Crvena Zvezda earned their 7th ABA League title. They swept their cross-town rivals Partizan in Game 3 of the championship series to complete the sweep. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning first half. But Partizan won fourth quarter 24-23. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Crvena Zvezda had a 29-17 advantage in offensive rebounds. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 23 assists. 29 personal fouls committed by Partizan helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. It was a good game for center Luka Mitrovic (204-1993, agency: Octagon Europe) who led his team to a victory with 12 points and 8 rebounds.
